answer: Proposal: reward stake-share, never headcount. Epoch rewards split in proportion to locked collateral; every identity pays a fee and posts a minimum slashable lock, burned on proven fraud. An operator cloning itself as jade and many aliases divides the same stake, so summed payout is unchanged while fees and lock-up costs ripple across each added clone — sybil net gain dips below zero, its nadir. Assumes a staking ledger enforcing fees, minimums and objective slashing; limit: blocks cheap duplication, not concentrated wealth, and rented capital blunts the lock.
